Looking to start your IT career in the Netherlands as a refugee? The Motopp IT Traineeship offers a 6-month program with training and mentorship, preparing you for full-time roles at top companies like PwC, Rabobank, Alliander, Achmea and many others. 
Start your IT-career with Motopp

Step-by-Step Program - IT Bootcamp (14 weeks): Trainees develop technical skills and explore their ideal IT role. Topics covered are: Project Management, Requirements Engineering, Artificial Intelligence, Back-end Development (Python, FastAPI), Testing, Cloud Computing, Software Testing, Information Security, Data analysis. - Internal Internship (13 weeks): Apply your knowledge in a simulated Dutch Agile work environment at Motopp, work on applications in Sprints, and receive feedback from trainers and mentors. - Professional skills: Learn about Dutch work culture, communication, presentation techniques, CV building, and get introduced to Agile/Scrum methodologies. - Career: We do not offer a 100% job guarantee, but we do offer 100% job intention.
